q1.question: 💡 How does data saving work?
q1.answer: Everything is saved in your browser's localStorage. It's like a local mini-database that works only on your device. Data remains even if you close the browser, but is accessible only to you.

q2.question: 🔄 Can I use 3ASYWEALTH on multiple devices?
q2.answer: Yes! Export your data in CSV or JSON on one device, then import it on another. You can also save the file to a personal cloud (Google Drive, iCloud, Dropbox) to have it always synced.

q3.question: 🗑️ What happens if I clear my browser data?
q3.answer: If you clear your browsing data (cache, localStorage), you'll lose your assets. That's why it's important to export regularly a backup in CSV or JSON and save it in a safe place.

q4.question: 📊 Can I use Excel with exported files?
q4.answer: Absolutely! The CSV format is perfectly compatible with Excel, Google Sheets, Numbers and any other spreadsheet. You can do advanced analysis, custom charts or simply keep a readable backup.

q5.question: 🔐 Is it really safe? How can I be sure?
q5.answer: 3ASYWEALTH is open source! You can check the code on GitHub. There are no calls to external servers. You can open the browser tools (F12) and see in the Network tab that no requests are sent when you enter your data.

q6.question: 💰 Is it really free?
q6.answer: Yes, completely free. No hidden costs, no premium plans, no credit card required. It's an open source project (MIT License) created for those who want privacy and simplicity.

dataSaving.question: 💾 How does data saving work?
dataSaving.answer:
Your data is saved directly in your browser using localStorage. This means:

✅ Data stays on your device only
✅ No server uploads or cloud sync
✅ Works completely offline
✅ Instant save/load (no waiting)

⚠️ Important: If you clear your browser data or use incognito mode, your data will be lost. Always export your data regularly as backup!

multiDevice.question: 🔄 Can I use 3ASYWEALTH on multiple devices?
multiDevice.answer:
Since everything runs locally, your data doesn't automatically sync between devices. However, you can:

📤 Export your data as JSON or CSV from one device
📥 Import the same file on another device
💾 Keep a backup file in your cloud storage (Dropbox, Google Drive, etc.)

This manual sync gives you full control over where your data goes!

safety.question: 🔐 Is it really safe? How can I be sure?
safety.answer:
Absolutely! Here's how you can verify:

🔍 Open Source: Review all code on GitHub
🌐 Network Inspector: Open browser DevTools (F12) → Network tab
   You'll see ZERO requests to external servers
📱 Offline Mode: Turn off your internet - it still works!
🔒 No Tracking: No analytics, no cookies, no fingerprinting
✅ Local Storage: Data never leaves localStorage

We encourage technical users to audit the code and report any concerns!

dataSecurity.question: 🛡️ What if I lose my data?
dataSecurity.answer:
Prevention is key:

📤 Regular Exports: Use 'Export JSON' frequently
☁️ Cloud Backup: Save exports to Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.
💾 Multiple Copies: Keep backups on different devices
📧 Email: Send yourself a copy via email

Recovery:
• If you have an export file → Import it back
• If you cleared browser data → Lost (no server to recover from)
• If you used demo data → Reload demo data

Remember: Local-first means YOU control backups!
